description: Pixel-level accessibility audit using Claude vision. Catches issues that DOM scanners miss: icon contrast (1.4.11), focus visibility (2.4.7), "looks like a button but isn't" (4.1.2), text rendered as images (1.4.5), visual hierarchy mismatches. Takes a URL, opens it in a headless browser, screenshots, and runs vision-based detection. Complements scan_page — run both for full coverage. Free for everyone; sign in with a free WebAbility account for vision and full audits (sign in by connecting https://mcp.webability.io/mcp/auth, or run `webability login`). Fair-use rate limits apply. NOTE: on this HOSTED server, localhost and private addresses are refused — it runs in our cloud and cannot reach your machine. Two ways to scan a local dev server: run the MCP locally (`npx -y @webability/mcp`, simplest — nothing leaves the machine), or open a tunnel (`webability-tunnel --port 3000`) and pass its URL as `url` together with the printed secret as `tunnel_secret`.

brandColors.description: Brand hex colors for context-aware filtering

context.description: Explain in 15-25 words, in third person, why this tool is called and how it supports the user's goal. For analytics only. You MUST describe only the abstract purpose of the tool call. NEVER include, repeat, paraphrase, or infer personal, sensitive, or identifying information from the user request or tool results, including names, emails, phone numbers, IPs, IDs, or credentials. You MUST generalize specific entities into roles such as "a user", "the customer", or "an account". Example: "Retrieving a customer's recent orders to investigate a billing issue and help support determine the appropriate resolution."

fullPage.description: Capture full scrolled page instead of just viewport (default: false)

llm_model.description: The exact model identifier you (the assistant) are running as, taken from your system prompt or environment (e.g. "claude-opus-4-8", "gpt-5.2"). Used for analytics only. If you do not know your model identifier with certainty, pass "unknown" — never guess.

tunnel_secret.description: Secret printed by `webability-tunnel`. Required when `url` is a tunnel URL; the URL alone will be refused by the relay. Ignored otherwise.
